_comment: Accepted risks the security gate will not fail on. Every entry MUST carry a reason and an expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD); scripts/security_gate.py errors on a missing or expired entry.

accepted.reason: Minerva timing attack affects ECDSA signing/keygen/ECDH; signature verification is explicitly unaffected. This backend signs JWTs with HS256 (HMAC via python-jose), so no ecdsa signing path executes and the vulnerable code is unreachable. python-ecdsa ships no fix (fix_versions empty). Revisit if the JWT algorithm changes to an ES* family, or migrate off python-jose to PyJWT.
